name: plex-library
description: Read-only access to your Plex Media Server — browse libraries, search media, view watch history, and get personalized recommendations.
long_description: Connects Claude to your local Plex Media Server via the Model Context Protocol. Exposes 46+ read-only tools covering library browsing, search, metadata, watch history, viewing statistics, and AI-powered recommendations based on your actual watch history. No write operations are enabled — Claude cannot modify, delete, or reorganize anything in your library.

plex_token.title: Plex Token
plex_token.description: Your Plex authentication token (from Plex Web → DevTools → localStorage.getItem('myPlexAccessToken'))

plex_url.title: Plex Server URL
plex_url.description: The URL of your Plex Media Server

radarr_url.title: Radarr URL (optional)
radarr_url.description: URL of your Radarr instance, for movie search/tracking only — no indexers or download client are configured, so nothing can actually be downloaded

radarr_api_key.title: Radarr API Key (optional)
radarr_api_key.description: Found in Radarr → Settings → General → API Key

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Search media globally or in a library

tools.name: get_media_details
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for an item

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Personalized recommendations based on watch history

tools.name: radarr_search
tools.description: Search TMDB for a movie (tracking/metadata only — no indexers configured, nothing downloads)

tools.name: radarr_get_missing
tools.description: List monitored movies not yet available
